blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – International Boxing Federation (IBF) No. 8-ranked super bantamweight Kenneth Llover will have to wait three more weeks for his comeback fight after his scheduled October 24 bout against unbeaten Indian Neeraj Swami was moved to November 15, 2026. Gerry Peñalosa, Llover’s manager and head of GerryPens Promotions, announced the schedule change in a Facebook post, citing the failure of Indian boxer Sandeep Kumar to secure a permit to fight.
